subject.title: Heartbeat skipped reason 'target-none' is misleading when delivery is disabled by default

question: Should disabled-heartbeat-delivery diagnostics keep the shipped `reason: "target-none"` and add a human-readable hint/status rendering, or should the machine reason be renamed?
rationale: The current reason is present in tests and the latest release, so the implementation is small but the event contract shape needs maintainer intent before automation resumes.

options.title: Add hint, keep reason
options.body: Preserve `target-none` for machine consumers and add a human-readable disabled-delivery hint in the resolver/event/status path.

options.title: Rename the reason
options.body: Change the machine reason to a clearer value such as `delivery-disabled`, accepting compatibility risk for existing parsers.

options.title: Leave current output
options.body: Accept the current diagnostic wording and avoid adding a new event/status field.

recommendation.title: Add hint, keep reason
recommendation.body: Preserve `target-none` for machine consumers and add a human-readable disabled-delivery hint in the resolver/event/status path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged default-target change and is the clearest history-backed owner for the compatibility choice.
